title: Restaurant-Style Green Salads: Emulsified Dressings, Gentle Handling, and Finishing Touches
summary: America’s Test Kitchen host Lan Lam demonstrates practical, chef-tested techniques to elevate home green salads to restaurant quality. Key ideas include matching dressing to greens by tenderness and texture, constructing a quick emulsified vinaigrette (mayo, mustard, salt, molasses) with two oils and three additions to maintain emulsion, and dispersing dressing early to avoid uneven coating. The video also covers a thick-dressing method that starts in the bowl, hands-on dressing (with optional gloves) to minimize bruising, and a tasting step to fine-tune dressing balance with salt, pepper, and citrus. In addition to a simple no-recipe salad (arugula, lemon, Pecorino), Lam models finishing touches (lemon zest, cracked pepper) and offers make-ahead toppings such as candied nuts, shaved vegetables using ice-water, and crisp croutons. The transcript references specific tools (mason jar, mandolin, salad spinner) and practical kitchen tactics drawn from professional kitchens, adapted for home cooks.
